'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Thomas Whaley DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-combatreadiness-pre.gif|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
